Alright, my delightful students, gather 'round! Today, I'd like to introduce you to our special Italian guest, who's been known to embrace the stereotypes with a flair only an Italian could muster.

Now, this student is so Italian, they can stretch a coffee break into an espresso vacation, and a lunch break into a three-course feast with wine pairings. They even take naps after their afternoon siesta!

But fear not, for they've mastered the art of procrastination like a true Italian maestro. I mean, they can debate the finer points of espresso versus cappuccino while the rest of us are solving complex equations!

So let's all learn from our Italian comrade, for there's a certain je ne sais quoi to their approach to life, even if it does make us question the efficiency of our own study habits. Ciao, bella! Let's get this roast started!
